name: NJ-05
label: Safe D

key_factors: Gottheimer's massive financial advantage ($12.8M cash vs ~$8K)
Incumbency in a D+2 district with a favorable environment
model.rationale: Gottheimer holds an overwhelming cash edge and both Kalshi and Polymarket price his reelection near 97-98%, consistent with the fundamentals-based margin. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict, the race stays Safe D.
model.watch: A late outside-spending surge against Gottheimer or a sharply worse national environment for Democrats could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Josh Gottheimer seeks a fifth term in a northern New Jersey district that leans slightly Democratic. He enters the general election with a dominant financial position, having raised about $4.8 million and holding nearly $12.8 million on hand, while Republican Sean Kirrane has raised only about $56,000 with minimal outside support. No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for the race.

Prediction markets strongly favor Gottheimer, with Kalshi at 96% and Polymarket at 98% for the Democrat. Fundamentals point the same way: incumbency, a modest district lean, and a favorable national environment suggest a comfortable double-digit margin, though the absence of polling leaves some uncertainty around the exact size of the win.
